design_notes: single-center, randomized, open-label, cross-over phase-2 trial

population.condition: type 2 diabetes mellitus without established cardiovascular disease
key_inclusion_criteria: diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus at least 6 months before enrolment
HbA1c level of no more than 86 mmol/mol at screening
drug-naïve or receiving oral glucose-lowering therapies for at least 12 weeks before screening
normal LVEF and no prior myocardial infarction or ischemia suggestive of significant epicardial coronary artery disease on screening CMR

arms.name: liraglutide
arms.dose: 0.6 mg once-weekly, titrated to 1.2 mg once-weekly

arms.name: pioglitazone
arms.dose: 15 mg once-daily, increased by 15 mg every other week to 45 mg once-daily

outcomes.name: Change in myocardial perfusion — global stress myocardial blood flow (stress-MBF)
